submitted.rationale: Index 19 (In0.35Sb0.65) had the highest measured EQE, 0.081%. XRD shows a single rutile-type phase there. The nearby In3Sb5O12 phase sits near the hull, with a predicted gap of ~2.8 eV, below the 3.2 eV photon energy.

rejected.reason: EQE 0.066%, lower. XRD shows mixed In2O3 and rutile phases.
EQE 0.058%. EQE falls off at higher Sb content.

consultations.verdict: Support: MACE puts In11Sb3O24 (In 0.786, matches index 6) on the hull (0 eV/atom). MEGNet HSE gap is 1.91 eV, well below the 3.2 eV photon energy, so it should absorb. XRD best-matches this phase.

Mild support: MACE puts In3Sb5O12 (In 0.375, close to index 19) near the hull (0.018 eV/atom). Its gap of ~2.8 eV is below 3.2 eV, so it should absorb. Measuring here tests the Sb-rich end against In-rich index 6.

Weak support: Sb6O13 (a likely Sb-rich co-phase) has a predicted gap of ~2.05 eV, so it absorbs at 3.2 eV. With EQE rising toward the Sb-rich side (0.066 at index 6, 0.081 at index 19), I'm probing further along the Sb-rich end with the last measurement.
